title: Salomon Trail Gaiters High — product specifications
claims: Trail Gaiters High weigh 5 oz per unit and are marketed for trail running; body fabric is 78% polyamide and 22% elastane, back body 100% polyester, insert 88% styrene-butadiene rubber and 12% polyester.
The gaiters prevent gravel, snow, thorns and loose debris from reaching the feet and protect ankle bones from shocks and scrapes; they attach with a Velcro closure and an under-foot strap.
Care instructions: hand wash cold at 30 C; do not bleach, dry clean, iron or tumble dry.
